hierarchy: 1. stable provider player id (ESPN athlete_id) - only when the id is a positive provider id and the audit showed stability
2. proven cross-source deterministic mapping (NONE exists: recruit_ids 0% populated)

rules.stitch_history_across_schools: only for rule 1; a player's all-team skill history follows the athlete_id, role / deployment history stays current-team (same split as the NHL shared state)
rules.fuzzy_name_matching: FORBIDDEN as a join; names may be used only to VALIDATE a provider-id match (a conflicting name blocks the stitch)
rules.placeholder_ids: negative ids are never stitched across schools
rules.unresolved: history does NOT transfer across schools; the player is treated as a newcomer with the position / school prior
rules.same_name_two_ids_on_one_team_season: collision flagged; neither id inherits the other's history
